events.title: Into the Mountains and Seas: A Dev Playthrough of Taiyi Saga
events.summary: How do you turn the strange beasts and lost lands of the Classic of Mountains and Seas (Shan Hai Jing) into a game?We're jumping into the Taiyi Saga demo ourselves for Next Fest — playing from the very beginning and talking about where the designs came from, and which parts we reworked way too many times.Stream time: Oct 21, 11:00 PM PT / Oct 22, 06:00 UTCCome hang out in the chat, and if it looks like your kind of game, a wishlist goes a long way.

events.title: What's It Like to Tame Beasts in the World of the Classic of Mountains and Sea
